title: Maximizing directed cycles in tournaments
summary: Determining the combinatorial structures that maximize the number of prescribed substructures is a central theme in extremal combinatorics. Grzesik, Král', Lovász and Volec showed that when $\ell$ is not divisible by $4$, the random tournament contains asymptotically the most directed cycles of length $\ell$ among all $n$-vertex tournaments. In the paper, we resolve the remaining cases where $\ell$ is divisible by $4$.
